suites.title: Governing authority and status consistency

scenarios.requirement: Resolve document precedence and verify every owner-approved baseline has synchronized Accepted status and timestamp.
Inject conflicting status, authority, or phase-order fixtures and require deterministic failure without modifying source documents.

suites.title: Schema registry and contract integrity

scenarios.requirement: Validate every defined schema against the pinned dialect, resolve every reference, and verify registry identity, version, path, and immutable predecessor.
Reject unknown versions, duplicate keys, unresolved references, extra fields, invalid UTF-8, negative zero, and mismatched registry identities.

suites.title: Control coverage, capability non-claims, and production absence

scenarios.requirement: Map every Critical and High control to planned work and proof while every unproven capability remains UNVERIFIED with a fallback.
Verify production credentials, endpoints, deployment, Stripe Live, default-branch mutation, telemetry upload, and undocumented integrations are absent or prohibited.

suites.title: Packaged shell boot and platform profile

scenarios.requirement: Build, install, launch, quit, and relaunch a clean package on the minimum and current MACOS_ARM64_V1 operating systems with pinned runtime versions.
Recover from renderer, worker, and unclean application termination without enabling execution authority or retaining unmanaged state.

suites.title: Renderer, preload, and main privilege boundaries

scenarios.requirement: Prove sandboxing, context isolation, disabled Node integration, CSP, navigation denial, sender validation, and narrow typed preload methods in the packaged app.
Reject generic IPC, raw process, filesystem, database, credential, debugger, and arbitrary message access from renderer and preload compromise fixtures.

suites.title: IPC rejection, navigation safety, and main-loop responsiveness

scenarios.requirement: Reject malformed, oversized, duplicate, unknown, stale, cross-window, subframe, navigation, permission, and external-protocol requests without side effects.
Saturate parser, stream, image, and database worker fixtures while the main loop remains responsive and trusted stop UI remains reachable.

suites.title: Typed operation normalization and tier policy

scenarios.requirement: Classify complete typed Green, Yellow, Red, and Black synthetic plans from exact actor, target, environment, capability, data, and effect fields.
Reject unknown schemas, generic command strings, label spoofing, capability expansion, omitted effects, production targets, and every attempted tier downgrade.

suites.title: Approval, action-plan binding, and single-use grants

scenarios.requirement: Bind fresh trusted owner approval and one short-lived single-use grant to the exact immutable Red action plan and current policy.
Deny stale, replayed, forged, expired, reused, cross-session, changed-target, changed-evidence, self-approved, and Black-tier grant attempts.

suites.title: Audit durability, keys, continuity, and degraded safety

scenarios.requirement: Inject partial writes, disk full, flush failure, key loss, sequence races, fork, rollback, truncation, anchor outage, and restart at every durable boundary.
Deny new effects when required assurance is unavailable while emergency stop proceeds without audit acknowledgement and exact assurance ranges remain honest.

suites.title: Typed execution and capsule isolation contract

scenarios.requirement: Execute a proven typed local test operation through the selected capsule with exact executable, arguments, mounts, network, environment, limits, and generation.
Block shells, wrappers, interpreters, hooks, aliases, inherited credentials, undeclared network, mount escape, detachment, and direct spawn imports.

suites.title: Scoped cancellation and verified cleanup

scenarios.requirement: Cancel during spawn, descendant creation, output flood, file hold, network request, graceful stop, forced stop, and supervisor crash.
Terminate every owned descendant, handle, mount, browser, and remote request in scope while unrelated processes and workspaces survive unchanged.

suites.title: Independent watchdog under saturation and crash recovery

scenarios.requirement: Saturate renderer, main, workers, IPC, audit, persistence, CPU, memory, disk, descriptors, and output while the independent watchdog still stops owned effects within its deadline.
Reconcile orphaned capsules and external requests after crash without blind retry, false cleanup success, or invented effect outcome.

suites.title: Generation-fenced leases and workspace containment

scenarios.requirement: Reject stale or forged leases, path replacement, symlink, hard link, case or Unicode collision, nested repository, mount crossing, and ownership conflict.
Reconcile worktrees, leases, open handles, metadata, and interrupted cleanup after restart without adopting an unknown workspace.

suites.title: Typed local Git object and ref mutation

scenarios.requirement: Create only the reviewed commit and topic-ref update from an immutable manifest through fixed Git plumbing and current lease identity.
Block hooks, filters, aliases, config, environment, replacement binaries, symbolic refs, detached refs, refspec substitution, path escape, and default-ref mutation.

suites.title: Remote Git compare-and-swap and reconciliation

scenarios.requirement: Deny remote identity, URL, ref, expected-old-object, credential scope, policy, or environment mismatch before push.
Reconcile timeout, disconnect, concurrent update, server rejection, and unknown push outcome without force, duplicate mutation, merge, or default-branch write.

suites.title: Protected packet channel and bounded framing

scenarios.requirement: Establish a fresh process-bound protected channel and exchange a valid versioned frame with exact peer, session, generation, provenance, size, and sequence.
Treat stdout and stderr markers as text and reject endpoint theft, peer substitution, malformed lengths, unknown versions, oversized frames, and untrusted control injection.

suites.title: Packet authentication, sequence, replay, and backpressure

scenarios.requirement: Reject forged authentication, nonce reuse, replay, reorder, duplicate, gap, session rollover, stale acknowledgement, and structural authority claims.
Enforce frame, queue, memory, rate, and time limits under flood while preserving emergency stop and reporting exact dropped or failed delivery state.

suites.title: Durable delivery, reconnect reconciliation, and provenance

scenarios.requirement: Reconcile disconnect and crash before and after durable receipt without false acknowledgement, duplicate authority, skipped sequence, or invented recipient state.
Preserve authenticated source separately from truth, approval, and observation claims and retain a manifested sanitized manual fallback for unavailable adapters.

suites.title: Ephemeral browser session, navigation, and permission isolation

scenarios.requirement: Create one fresh non-persistent dedicated test view for an exact approved origin and prove profile, frame, navigation, partition, and capture-state identity.
Deny redirects, popups, subframes, private network, certificate errors, external protocols, downloads, devices, permissions, storage reuse, and personal profiles.

suites.title: CDP allowlist and secret-safe canonical evidence

scenarios.requirement: Reject unallowlisted CDP methods, targets, fields, runtime evaluation, bodies, cookies, storage, console, authorization data, and capture during authentication.

Place synthetic canaries across every browser source and require either bounded canonical sanitized evidence or a typed gap with no canary in UI, prompt, packet, audit, file, database, cache, crash report, or export.

suites.title: Browser capture races, bounded load, and verified teardown

scenarios.requirement: Race navigation, frame replacement, debugger detach, target change, renderer crash, timeout, cancellation, and teardown interruption and reject stale or partial evidence.
Bound DOM, pixel, CPU, memory, network, worker, and event floods and verify view, debugger, storage, service-worker, connection, handler, and buffer teardown after stop or restart.

suites.title: Persistence admission, authoritative visibility, and bounded search

scenarios.requirement: Reject D0, raw packets, logs, browser bodies, malformed fields, arbitrary SQL, unrestricted FTS syntax, extensions, attach operations, and unknown storage paths before persistence.
Bound search tokens, operators, prefixes, results, time, memory, cancellation, pagination, and stale caches while every result rejoins current lifecycle and generation.

suites.title: Retention clocks, resumable deletion, and SQLite cleanup

scenarios.requirement: Exercise clock rollback and jump, overdue retention, open readers, crash, busy database, disk full, corrupt index, and every deletion checkpoint without restoring visibility.
Verify source, FTS, WAL, journals, temporary files, caches, artifacts, exports, and managed-copy state reach exact honest deletion outcomes with no stronger physical-erasure claim.

suites.title: Backup, restore, encryption, export, and independent verification

scenarios.requirement: Restore isolated managed backups through the deletion ledger and retention policy before exposure, then verify expiry, rewrite, key, and remaining-copy state.
Run a read-only independent verifier over binary-safe exports and report exact assurance ranges, provenance, gaps, key transitions, missing evidence, and unmanaged limitations.

suites.title: Skill discovery isolation and pre-admission snapshot

scenarios.requirement: Prove agents cannot discover proposal inbox bytes or write active roots and mark unsupported any platform whose ambient discovery cannot be isolated.
Reconcile dropped watch events and race root replacement, links, mounts, hard links, special files, source mutation, secret canaries, limits, and crashes before persistence.

suites.title: Strict bundle validation, complete manifest, review, and activation

scenarios.requirement: Reject malformed or ambiguous metadata, duplicate YAML keys, aliases, tags, name collisions, active formats, parser abuse, dependency drift, and incomplete manifests.
Bind inert complete-bundle review, tiered owner approval, target scope, expiry, dependency closure, and separate activation to one immutable admitted digest.

suites.title: Exact skill invocation, effect routing, revocation, and cross-agent publication

scenarios.requirement: Load and execute only exact active broker bytes with progressive disclosure and capability intersection while every requested effect re-enters normal typed policy and grant paths.
Revoke metadata, queued and future loads, dependent bundles, running scripts, caches, and target publication across restart while disclosing already-delivered context as non-recallable.

suites.title: Canonical evidence admission, manifests, chunks, and capacity

scenarios.requirement: Capture exact permitted bytes before loss, bind immutable manifests and deterministic ordered chunks, and reconstruct and verify every retained range.

Exercise policy-forbidden capture, truncation, queue and disk exhaustion, crash during commit, missing, duplicate, reordered, corrupt, expired, and deleted chunks with explicit gaps and no false success.

suites.title: Code, log, DOM, and visual derivation safety

scenarios.requirement: Force Tree-sitter ERROR and MISSING recovery, unsupported and mixed languages, parser drift, timeout, crash, binary, generated, configuration, import-only, and cross-file cases into exact chunk fallback.
Test localized critical visual changes, normalization drift, DOM disagreement, log interleaving, repetition, and hash similarity while critical canonical source is never suppressed.

suites.title: Canonical approval binding, honest replay, and evidence export

scenarios.requirement: Deny approval from a summary, pHash, thumbnail, stale source, unavailable range, mismatched digest, recursive derivation, or incomplete provenance chain.
Order replay by verified sequence, stop reconstruction at the first gap, preserve unknown outcomes, and reject incomplete, reordered, corrupt, mis-versioned, or orphaned exports.

suites.title: GitHub leased topic branch and draft PR workflow

scenarios.requirement: Create one leased topic branch, immutable commit manifest, reconciled push, and exact-base draft PR in the dedicated non-production test repository.
Prove least privilege, protected default ref, exact remote identity, and no agent merge, production repository, force, bypass, or owner impersonation authority.

suites.title: Approved Claude handoff and end-to-end agent workflow

scenarios.requirement: Complete planning, typed execution, canonical evidence, authenticated handoff, acknowledgement, owner approval, cancellation, and recovery through the exact approved non-production adapter or manual fallback.
Reject undocumented IPC, UI automation, ambient sessions, forged provenance, unavailable recipient, changed payload, duplicate delivery, and model claims presented as observed truth.

suites.title: Stripe isolation, production denial, and manual fallbacks

scenarios.requirement: Prove offline mocks make no network or credential access and every production endpoint, identity, credential, environment, and mutation remains prohibited.
Run Stripe Sandbox only if its separate ADR and dedicated test identity are accepted; otherwise require an explicit unsupported result and safe mock fallback.

suites.title: Release abuse, fault, performance, accessibility, and clean-install matrix

scenarios.requirement: Run every required suite from a clean install on minimum and current physical Apple Silicon profiles with migrations, recovery, upgrade, downgrade, and fresh data stores.
Verify keyboard, VoiceOver, focus, contrast, reduced motion, zoom, approval, denial, stop, error, gap, and assurance states without content overlap or hidden authority.

suites.title: Signing, notarization, entitlements, supply chain, update, and rollback

scenarios.requirement: Verify exact code signatures, hardened runtime, notarization ticket, helpers, entitlements, dependency lock, native modules, packaged resources, and prohibited entitlement absence.
Reject tampered, substituted, expired, downgraded, unauthorized, or partially applied update artifacts and recover through an authenticated owner-approved rollback without schema or data loss.

suites.title: Independent evidence verification and release decision

scenarios.requirement: Verify the binary-safe review package, control matrix, reports, limitations, checkpoints, anchor receipts, exact assurance ranges, and clean-environment verifier without DOSAI write authority.
Require independent review, zero unresolved Critical or High findings, owner go or conditional-go, and evidence-backed final capability states and release limitations before publication.
